settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order is placed, you'll receive a confirmation email with a tracking link. Use it to monitor your shipment's status in real time until delivery.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer: Our customer support team is available to assist you with any queries or concerns. Reach out through our contact page and we'll respond as soon as possible.

settings.question: Can I modify or cancel my order after placing it?
settings.answer: If you wish to make changes or cancel your order, please contact our support team promptly. We'll do our best to accommodate your request depending on the order status.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery timelines vary based on your location and chosen shipping method. Estimated delivery dates are displayed at checkout, and delays may occasionally occur due to unforeseen circumstances.

settings.heading: Discover more in our FAQ
settings.subheading: Have a question or comment? Don't be shy: Reach out and say hi!
settings.card_text: Shoot our team an email & we'll get back to you ASAP
